solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Time when the hands come together

definitions.text: Time when the hands come together

parts.words: Time when the hands come together
parts.note: a clock's hour and minute hands meet exactly at noon and midnight, an hour that the clue describes rather than names

explanation.definitionFit: At noon and midnight both clock hands point straight up together at the top of the dial.

clue.text: Indisposed star can't perform

indicators.note: someone indisposed is out of sorts, so these letters are knocked out of their usual order

parts.note: the apostrophe is ignored, giving the four letters as written

explanation.surface: A celebrity too ill to go on stage cancels the show.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Indisposed' rearranges STAR and CANT. 'Perform' looks like the star's job but is the definition, in its sense of carry out business.
explanation.definitionFit: To transact is to carry out or conduct a deal, a synonym of perform in its business sense.

clue.text: Queen duty-bound to keep physically fit

indicators.note: the duty is bound round the Queen, enclosing her letters inside it

parts.note: excise is a duty or tax on goods
ER, Elizabeth Regina, is the standard crossword Queen

explanation.surface: The monarch feels obliged to stay in good shape.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Duty-bound' reads as one word for obliged, but 'bound' is the container signal, and 'keep' belongs with the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: To exercise is to train the body, which is what keeping physically fit involves.

clue.text: Failing to become a deputy

definitions.meaning: a failing is a moral weakness or fault
a ...-president or ...-captain acts as deputy, and the prefix is used as a noun for such a person

explanation.definitionFit: Vice means both a character flaw and, as a noun, a deputy standing in for another.

clue.text: Cadet due for promotion, having been taught well

indicators.note: promotion moves a cadet up and around the ranks, here shifting these letters into a new order

explanation.surface: A trainee officer who is up for a step in rank has had good schooling.
explanation.walkthrough: 'For promotion' looks like military career talk but signals a rearrangement of CADET and DUE.
explanation.definitionFit: An educated person has received a good schooling, that is, been taught well.

clue.text: Foolhardy rascal can show concern

parts.note: a little devil is a mischievous rascal
may expresses permission, as can does
to care is to show concern

explanation.surface: A reckless rogue is nonetheless able to be caring.
explanation.definitionFit: A devil-may-care attitude is reckless and heedless of danger, close to foolhardy.

clue.text: Is unable to lean over

definitions.meaning: the contraction of cannot, written with an apostrophe
to tilt or slope to one side

explanation.definitionFit: Without its apostrophe the word means to tilt; with it, the contraction meaning cannot.

clue.text: Distressing twitch about to irritate

indicators.note: the twitch goes about, that is around, the word for irritate

parts.note: a tic is an involuntary twitch
to rag someone is to tease or irritate them

explanation.surface: A nervous spasm that annoys can be upsetting.
explanation.walkthrough: 'About' is the container signal; 'twitch' and 'irritate' read as one nervous reaction but are separate pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: Something tragic is deeply sad and upsetting, so distressing.

clue.text: They hold up shelves

definitions.meaning: hold-ups are things that make you late
as a verb, to shelve a plan is to postpone it

explanation.definitionFit: Delays are hold-ups, and to delay is to put off, as shelving a plan does.

clue.text: Instrument that won't play a principal part

definitions.text: Instrument that won't play a principal part

parts.words: Instrument that won't play a principal part
parts.note: in law a body that acts on someone's behalf is a means or instrument, never itself the principal, though the surface suggests a musician in a supporting role

explanation.definitionFit: An agency acts for a principal, as an agent does, rather than as principal in its own right.

clue.text: Just take a trip in the twilight

parts.note: just means even, as in fair and level
a trip is a stumble or fall

explanation.surface: Someone simply stumbles over at dusk.
explanation.definitionFit: Evenfall is a poetic word for the coming of evening, the time of twilight.

clue.text: Soldier-husband who tries to supply all one's needs

definitions.text: who tries to supply all one's needs

parts.note: a general is a high-ranking soldier
to husband resources is to save or store them

explanation.surface: A military man who is married tries to provide for every need of his household.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Husband' looks like a married man but is the verb meaning conserve, giving STORE.
explanation.definitionFit: A general store is a shop stocking all sorts of goods, aiming to meet every everyday need.

clue.text: Rifle fire

definitions.meaning: to rifle is to plunder or ransack
to fire someone is to dismiss them from a job

explanation.definitionFit: Sack means both plunder a town and dismiss an employee.

clue.text: He will shortly ring — for your reply

parts.note: he will shortened is the contraction he'll, its apostrophe ignored
O is ring-shaped

explanation.surface: A man promises to phone soon so you can answer.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'ring' sounds like a phone call, which fits the definition: the usual reply on picking up a ringing phone.
explanation.definitionFit: It is the standard greeting spoken in reply when you answer a phone.

clue.text: It's purely symbolic

parts.note: a white flower traditionally stands for purity, so it is symbolic of being pure, not merely a token

explanation.definitionFit: The white lily is a traditional emblem of purity, especially in religious art.

clue.text: Band that breaks up?

indicators.note: in a down entry, up means the letters are read from the bottom upwards

parts.note: breaks, as in separates, means parts

explanation.surface: A musical group that splits up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Breaks up' reads as a band disbanding, but 'up' reverses PARTS. 'That' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A strap is a band of leather or fabric used to fasten or hold something.

clue.text: Good man gets a warning to say nothing and hide away

parts.note: a saint, abbreviated ST, is a good man
sh is the call for silence

explanation.surface: A virtuous man is told to keep quiet and go into hiding.
explanation.definitionFit: To stash is to hide something away in a secret place.

clue.text: Was dirt-cheap? Hardly!

parts.note: the opposite of very cheap is very expensive, and the phrase for that happens to mention the soil that dirt suggests

explanation.definitionFit: To cost the earth is an idiom for being extremely expensive, the reverse of dirt-cheap.

clue.text: Make a union defer tea break

indicators.note: breaking the words smashes their letters into a fresh order

explanation.surface: An instruction to put off the tea break and form a trade union.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tea break' reads as one phrase, but 'break' is the signal to rearrange DEFER and TEA.
explanation.definitionFit: To federate is to join states or groups together into a federation or union.

clue.text: One who takes off in a hurry?

definitions.text: One who takes off in a hurry?

parts.words: One who takes off in a hurry?
parts.note: takes off suggests leaving quickly, but here it means removing one's clothes before dashing about naked

explanation.definitionFit: A streaker strips naked and runs swiftly through a public place.

clue.text: He sent a cable setting out financial position

indicators.note: setting out the letters lays them down afresh in another order

explanation.surface: A man wires a message detailing a company's finances.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Setting out' seems to describe the cable's content but rearranges HE SENT A CABLE.
explanation.definitionFit: A balance sheet sets out a company's assets and liabilities, showing its financial position.

clue.text: Foreign office desk?

definitions.meaning: the French word for an office, used in English for many agencies

explanation.definitionFit: The word is French for office and in English also names a writing desk.

clue.text: Information a female found in Switzerland

parts.note: gen is slang for information
Eva is a woman's name, standing for a female

explanation.surface: Facts about a woman discovered in the Alps.
explanation.definitionFit: Geneva is a city located in Switzerland.

clue.text: Employed you and me and another chap

parts.note: us is you and me together
Ed is a man's name

explanation.surface: Three people taken on for a job.
explanation.definitionFit: Used and employed are synonyms, as in a tool employed for a task.

clue.text: Enter the office uninvited?

parts.note: office here means a position of power, such as a throne, taken without right rather than a workplace walked into

explanation.definitionFit: To usurp is to seize a position or power without legal right.

clue.text: We are — or used to be

definitions.meaning: the plural past tense of the verb to be

explanation.definitionFit: Read as a contraction it is we are; as a verb it is the past plural of be.

clue.text: A convict turned up for the festivity

indicators.note: in a down entry, turned up means the letters are read from the bottom upwards

parts.note: an old lag is a convict

explanation.surface: A prisoner arrived for the party.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Turned up' looks like arriving, but reverses A and LAG.
explanation.definitionFit: A gala is a festive celebration or special entertainment.

clue.text: Finish second best

parts.note: top means best, as in top marks

explanation.surface: To end up in the runner-up spot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Second best' reads as one phrase meaning runner-up, but it splits into S and TOP.
explanation.definitionFit: To stop is to finish or bring to an end.

clue.text: Lift to reveal switch

indicators.note: switching the letters swaps them into another order

explanation.surface: Raising a cover to expose a hidden button.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Switch' looks like the button on a lift but rearranges TO REVEAL.
explanation.definitionFit: Elevator is the American word for the British lift.

clue.text: Army retreat, then change direction to do this

definitions.text: Army retreat, then change direction to do this

indicators.note: a retreating army goes backwards, so its letters are read in reverse

parts.note: TA is the Territorial Army, Britain's volunteer reserve
to tack is to change course, as a sailing boat does

explanation.surface: Military tactics: pull back, then turn round and strike.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue describes a counter-offensive: falling back and then turning round to strike the enemy.
explanation.definitionFit: Turning back on the enemy after a withdrawal is to go on the offensive.

clue.text: Girl was about to enter without warning

parts.note: Una is a girl's name

indicators.note: the word for about is going to enter, that is go inside, the word was

parts.note: re means about or concerning

explanation.surface: A young woman was on the point of coming in unannounced.
explanation.walkthrough: 'About to enter' reads as on the point of coming in, but RE enters WAS, giving WARES.
explanation.definitionFit: Caught unawares means taken by surprise, without warning.

clue.text: Seem a very quiet listener

parts.note: pp, pianissimo, is the musical marking for very quiet
the ear is the organ that listens

explanation.surface: An attentive person who seems silent.
explanation.definitionFit: To appear is to seem, as in he appears tired.
